caption: The video captures a top-down view of a clear green pond where several koi drift slowly among submerged stems, floating leaves, and pink flowers. The white koi with red patches in the upper area glide gradually rightward, while the smaller red-and-white koi on the left shifts its tail angle. Near the middle, a pale cream koi stays in place, undulating and sweeping its tail, beside a small multicolored koi that turns its orientation. At the bottom-left, a white, red, and black koi slides toward the frame edge and grows more cropped. The two dark blue-purple koi at the bottom-right rotate and drift partly out of view. An orange shape emerges at the left edge midway through and moves inward, while surface ripples keep shifting.
